It doesn’t even work well… the pop ups are annoying and I haven’t seen an increase in sales at all.

This is the worst app in Shopify, super expensive, and a scam.

Sales Pop is certainly not a scam and works very well for thousands of happy Shopify stores.

I understand that you added Sales Pop to your Shopify store after being offered a 100% discount from our partner Book that App.

Unfortunately, when you cancelled your subscription to Book that App you were no longer eligible for the discount. [...] I would be extremely careful installing this app.

I recently discovered Sales Pop was charging my store $299/month through Shopify app billing. I did not realize the app could auto-upgrade up to that amount based on usage unless auto-upgrade was disabled.

In my opinion, that is a very risky billing setup for small businesses, especially for a sales popup app. Even if this is technically disclosed during installation, I do not think the pricing, session limits, and auto-upgrade risk were clear enough.

I have uninstalled the app and requested a refund/credit, along with confirmation that there will be no future billing.

I would not recommend this app unless you are absolutely sure you understand the billing, session limits, auto-upgrade settings, and cancellation process. [...] We're so glad you are enjoying Sales Pop and thanks for taking the time to share your feedback!
